top_categories.workout_context: 75 miles on flat to gently rolling urban terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gran Fondo Argentina's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before October.
Gran Fondo Argentina's flat to gently rolling urban terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 75 miles.
Gran Fondo Argentina's flat to gently rolling urban terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Base fitness for Gran Fondo Argentina. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
When someone attacks on flat to gently rolling urban terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gran Fondo Argentina. Train it until it feels boring.
The aerobic base that lets you ride flat to gently rolling urban terrain at tempo for 75 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
At Gran Fondo Argentina, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Gran Fondo Argentina, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Gran Fondo Argentina's flat to gently rolling urban terrain actually does to you.
2-minute all-out efforts on flat to gently rolling urban terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

race_overlay.heat: October in Parque Sarmiento, Buenos Aires, Argentina can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Gran Fondo Argentina. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Gran Fondo Argentina’s 75 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Gran Fondo Argentina requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on flat to gently rolling urban terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Race Simulation, and Road Specific to prepare you for 75 miles of flat to gently rolling urban terrain in Parque Sarmiento, Buenos Aires, Argentina.
